item.tib: tshe dbang drag 'khros kyi gdon bzlog me dpung dgu sgril
item.coloph: de ltar 'chi med rig 'dzin chen po'i bka'/ g.yung drung gsal ba la sogs grub pa'i gshen/ las skal ldan la gtad gnyer dam du mdzad/ phyis su bon chos dar nub byung ba'i skabs/ 'gro la sman phyir rig 'dzin rnam gsum gyis/ lo tsa'i brda' yig bris te dgongs rgyas gdab/ phyi rab (rabs) don du zangs brag ri la sbas/ phyis su rten 'brel phun tshogs lnga shar tshe/ nges med sprul skus rnyed par shog/ phyis su bdag 'dra gshen sprul thugs rje nyi ma khyung gser (ser) dpon 'khor chab gcig (chabs cig) gnas mchog 'o ma stag rtse la bskor ba byon skabs/ rten 'brel gyi rtags 'ga' shar te/ zangs brag rin chen 'bar ba'i mdun zhor brag dmar tsi ta 'dra ba nas khrom gter du rnyed ste (de) lo mang bka' rgya gdab/ phyis su hor sras bsod nams rgyal mtshan sogs/ bstan sbyin bu slob rnams nas nye bar bskul ngor/ g.yu brag seng ge gnam rdzongs kyi (rdzong gi) nye char gshen gyi bla brang du bon 'chad pa'i thun mtshams su shog ser bod yig tu phab pa'o//
